ble._comment: Use this to overwrite default service/characteristic UUIDs in constants.py

recording._comment: Reverse-engineered and byte-level cross-validated against both a real captured command and a real captured INCOMING_CONTROL echo (see docs/recording.md). echo_operation is the operation byte the camera itself uses when reporting this category/parameter (distinct from operation=0/ASSIGN used by the controller's command). Confirmed via CameraSession's echo-based verification (examples/record_start_stop.py) across 3/3 consistent start/stop cycles on real hardware.
